text_block_list.text:
It seems Mayano Top Gun has a visitor.
Pausing training, we headed to the school gates, and—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right~☆
Are you Maya's guest?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Um, you see, you see...
Please take my fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, what cute stationery!
Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see~.
"I watched the school race with my dad."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“The strong and cute Maya-chan
is my number one prize!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Is that so?☆
Maya gets first place~~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Hey Maya-chan, can we take a picture together?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆
Trainer-chan, could you take a picture for me?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay~, it turned out great♪
Since we took it, let's decorate it all out!

Afterward,
perhaps motivated by interacting with the fans—

For once, Mayano Top Gun
participated eagerly in her training.
